questions.question: Barun starts from Point Y and drives 19 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 28 km, turns left and drives 17 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 59 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 59 km. He takes a left turn, drives 36 km. He then turns right, drives 9 km and stops at Point Z.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All rabbits are squirrel.

Some squirrels are rats.

All rats are mammals.

Conclusions:

(I) Some mammals are squirrel.

(II) Some rats are rabbits
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16b7b15b5a7a0a5a9488fb33f3be593674ae85e125556e071fbba006c2bbec44.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some mammals are squirrel → **True **(As, Some squirrels are rats, All rats are mammals. so, Some mammals are squirrel holds true)

(II) Some rats are rabbits → False (As, there is no direct relation between rats and rabbits. so, some rats are rabbits can be a possibility but definite).

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the corrrect answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question:
If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

103 C (64 A8) B 2 C 9 B 3 D 33 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

According to the question, the letters are interchanged as follows:

 
 

 Original Letter
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 New Symbol
 ÷
 ×
 +
 −
 
 

Now, given the equation: 103 C (64 A 8) B 2 C 9 B 3 D 33 = ?

After interchanging the specified letters, the new equation is:

103 + (64 ÷ 8) × 2 + 9 × 3 − 33 = ?

Perform operations according to BODMAS:

⇒ 103 + __**(64 ÷ 8)**__ × 2 + 9 × 3 − 33

⇒ 103 + __**8 × 2**__ + __**9 × 3**__ − 33

⇒ __**103 + 16**__ + 27 − 33

⇒ __**119 + 27**__ − 33

⇒ __**146 − 33**__

⇒ 113

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: Prince ranked 24th from the top and 39th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
Given:

Prince's rank from the top = 24th

Prince's rank from the bottom = 39th

The formula for the total number of persons in a row is:

**Total persons = (Rank from one end) + (Rank from other end) - 1**

= (Prince's rank from top) + (Prince's rank from bottom) - 1

= 24 + 39 - 1

= 63 - 1

**= 62 students.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

131 ÷ 6 + 1818 × 18 − 23 = ?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png]

__

• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

131 ÷ 6 + 1818 × 18 − 23 = ?

Replace the operators with their corresponding new meanings:

131 × 6 − 1818 ÷ 18 + 23 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS rule:

= **131 × 6**__ − __**1818 ÷ 18**__ + 23

= __**786 − 101**__ + 23

= __**685 + 23**__

= 708

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. U has an exam on Saturday. Only 4 people have an exam between S and T, neither of whom has an exam on Monday. P has an exam immediately after R, and V has an exam immediately before R. T has an exam after P. How many people have an exam after S?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

3) P has an exam immediately after R, and V has an exam immediately before R.

This forms a consecutive block: V-R-P. This block requires three consecutive empty slots.
